weighting_note: Experiment design and stakeholder communication carry as much weight as SQL; dashboards alone are not enough.

signals.criterion: SQL analysis on a production warehouse
signals.evidence_full: Wrote SQL against a warehouse to answer business questions with stated outcomes
signals.evidence_partial: Lists SQL or reporting without stated outcomes

signals.evidence_full: Designed experiments, set sample sizes and read results that changed a decision
signals.evidence_partial: Reported experiment results designed by others
signals.jd_phrase: Design and read A/B tests on onboarding and pricing

signals.evidence_full: Built acquisition, activation or retention analyses or dashboards used by a growth team
signals.jd_phrase: Build and maintain growth dashboards for acquisition, activation and retention

signals.criterion: Clear written communication with business teams
signals.evidence_full: Wrote findings or presented analysis that non-technical teams acted on
signals.evidence_partial: Mentions stakeholder reporting without an outcome
signals.jd_phrase: Clear written communication with business stakeholders

signals.criterion: Python or R for analysis and forecasting
signals.evidence_full: Built cohort, forecasting or statistical models in Python or R
signals.evidence_partial: Uses Python or R for data cleaning only
signals.jd_phrase: Build simple forecasting and cohort models
